_comment: Every form number this product is allowed to print, and the source that
proves it exists. Anything form-number-shaped that is NOT in this registry
is treated as a fabrication by verify:wv-form and fails the build.
This exists because 'Virginia Form #680' shipped for about a year. It was
never a document — 680 is a section of regulation 12VAC35-105. Nobody
caught it because nothing checked form numbers against sources. Now
something does. To add a number here you must paste the URL you read it
off, and 'a competitor's site said so' is not a source.

verified.label: Form 4119
verified.title: Residential Support Services (RSS) and Supervised Living (SL) Service Delivery Log
verified.notes: Real and cited on /states, but NOT reproduced. It is optional (HCS Billing Requirements §3850 says 'may'), it is a service delivery log rather than a progress note, and it is a dynamic XFA PDF that standard PDF libraries cannot fill. Cite it; never claim to produce it.

known_fabrications.label: Form #680
known_fabrications.reality: No such form. DBHDS numbers its forms with an OL- prefix. 680 is a section of regulation 12VAC35-105, and the state publishes a rule rather than a document.
known_fabrications.status: removed from runtime; README still carries the old language and is tracked separately

document_codes_not_form_numbers.note: Named in West Virginia's IDDW provider manual as the Direct-Support Service Log. We cite the manual's requirement but reproduce the Progress Note, not the Service Log. Not a form number printed on the page we reproduce, which is why the WV template's form_number is null.
